verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency or region selection. Export (docs-9), 2FA (docs-31) and permissions (docs-29) are adjacent privacy features and earn no credit for this story.
